name: mccor-labs
description: Infrastructure and tooling for mccor-labs. Node surface exists only to run scripts/.

scripts.//dev: op authorization is per-process and TTY-bound (a prompt per invocation), so only dev/build are wrapped rather than every script; build:raw is the unwrapped escape hatch for a build against an unconfigured/locked vault.
scripts.verify: pnpm -F web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -F web lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm -F web test:run && pnpm build

//: @playwright/test is pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged: 1.61.0 is the version whose bundled browser revision matches the revision installed in ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright. A caret range floats to a version that wants a different revision, and the suite then cannot launch a browser until someone runs `playwright install` and downloads one. Re-pin only alongside a deliberate `playwright install`.
